payload.blocks: §7 task list of ds-h3fvnp6qbt (head communication); the owner door and grant-request parts go on without it
payload.headline: Which door is the one guaranteed head-to-head channel: the mailbox, fixed inside the cage?

parts.cause: The mailbox was built for unconfined sessions: a confined send hits a read-only event store and a confined read needs a record lock it cannot write (p-ia2v33b54u, p-rchuoa2v3k). Mail queued for an old generation is also lost on rotation (p-bifjfd5rix). The owner door (question store) and the grant request for an unlisted verb already work for every head.

options.does: Mailbox send and read go through the request socket like other head verbs; mail follows a rotation; every refusal names its cause. The mailbox stays the one peer door.
options.gain: One peer door, already named in specs and skills; also fixes the reliability rows the owner raised on 2026-11-19.
options.harm: Touches mailbox, session-host and run-supervisor together.
options.label: Fix the mailbox in the cage

options.cost: Small: a kind and a rule.
options.does: A head raises a coordination event that names the peer; the supervisor carries it; the mailbox is left for unconfined sessions.
options.gain: No mailbox work now; the queue already works from the cage.
options.harm: Every peer message goes through the supervisor, so it is slower and the queue turns into chat; the mailbox stays broken for heads.
options.label: Use the supervision queue as the peer door

parts.recommendation: Fix the mailbox in the cage and keep it the one peer door; the queue stays for help and handoffs, the question store for the owner.

scope.allows: Choosing the peer door for ds-h3fvnp6qbt and folding p-rchuoa2v3k, p-ia2v33b54u and p-bifjfd5rix into its plan.
scope.forbids: Widening any persona's grants, or changing the owner door or the question-store wording (ds-cfsfcbknl6).

parts.what: A head must always be able to reach a peer head from inside its cage. Today Miu could not tell the heads-operate lead a probe result: mailbox send failed host-failed, the lead's mailbox read fails lock-unavailable, and session type only works on a session that an open supervision event names.
